title: disable_feature_flag
description: Disables a named feature flag in the relevant configuration file or feature-flag management system.

flag_name.description: The identifier of the feature flag to disable (e.g. 'dark_mode', 'new_checkout_flow').

target.description: An optional scope or audience for the flag (e.g. an environment name like 'production', a user segment like 'beta_users', or a service name).
